entries.8f06bcc3679449df: The group's sole reportable segment, a business that manufactures and wholesales bento boxes, rice balls, cooked breads, sushi, prepared foods, frozen foods and others. Products are manufactured at 8 factories, the Osaka Factory, Kansai Factory, Keiji Factory, Nagoya Factory, Chiba Factory, Okayama Factory, Hiroshima Factory and Shikoku Factory, for convenience stores, supermarkets, drugstores and others. Consolidated subsidiaries are 2 companies: S.F.D. Co., Ltd., which leases real estate, and Maitsu Bekarī Co., Ltd., which purchases and sells raw materials. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥61,974 million, the same as consolidated revenue.

entries.b3eb21b12e9c0224: It is a business model in which rice products such as bento boxes and rice balls are made at its own factories according to orders and sold wholesale to convenience stores, supermarkets, drugstores and others, earning consideration in return.
entries.b6a98a643a4ddb0e: It has formulated a medium-term management plan for the fiscal years ended March 2026 to March 2030, with the theme of challenging new value and new markets based on 'Ryōhin-zukuri' (quality product making), and sets 4 basic strategies: sales strategy, cost strategy, sustainability strategy and financial strategy. In its sales strategy, it will expand its frozen business, expand its sales areas such as delivery bento boxes for consumer cooperatives and products for café chains, and develop new markets. In its cost strategy, it will work to reduce costs through reviewing how key ingredients are procured, mechanization and labor-saving, and promoting DX.
